name: one-payalert
description: One PayAlert — One Platform. Multiple Banks. Instant Payment Alerts. (CAM Professional Technology)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @onepay/shared && npm run build -w @onepay/api && npm run build -w @onepay/merchant-web && npm run build -w @onepay/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @onepay/shared && npm run test -w @onepay/web-core && npm run test -w @onepay/api && npm run test -w @onepay/merchant-web && npm run test -w @onepay/admin-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @onepay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @onepay/ui && npm run typecheck -w @onepay/web-core && npm run typecheck -w @onepay/api && npm run typecheck -w @onepay/merchant-web && npm run typecheck -w @onepay/admin-web
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis rabbitmq
